# AI Business Automation & Agents

## Overview
AI Business Automation leverages unified AI cores to manage and execute over 50 automated tasks across departments including finance, HR, operations, sales, and customer support. The platform acts as a centralized "Automation Spine," consolidating fragmented software environments into a single self-learning backbone. It is designed to continuously adapt using real-time data and predictive intelligence.

## Technical Architecture
- **Model Deployment**: Pre-trained LLaMA-3 models are deployed per industry (finance, healthcare, e-commerce, real estate), with optional integration of GPT-4/5 and Gemini models for advanced reasoning and scenario prediction.
- **Self-Healing Workflows**: Autonomous workflows detect errors in APIs or service pipelines and automatically reroute traffic or patch broken endpoints (e.g., switching between Stripe, PayPal, or internal payment gateways).
